name: Jennifer Park
bio: With 12 years of experience in the Seattle real estate market, Jennifer specializes in urban properties and first-time homebuyers. Top producer in Capitol Hill and Pioneer Square for 5 consecutive years.

name: Michael Torres
bio: Michael brings 8 years of real estate expertise specializing in family homes and the greater Seattle area. Known for his thorough market analysis and negotiation skills. Licensed in both Washington and Oregon.

name: Sarah Kim
bio: Sarah specializes in luxury properties and new construction in Seattle's most desirable neighborhoods. Her background in architecture gives her unique insight into property valuation and renovation potential.

name: David Chen
bio: David focuses on commercial and investment properties across King County. He helps investors identify opportunities for development and portfolio growth. MBA from University of Washington.

name: Amanda Wright
bio: Amanda serves the Eastside communities of Bellevue, Kirkland, and Redmond. Specializing in tech-corridor relocations, she helps families transitioning to the Pacific Northwest find their perfect home.
